description_en: Call the ListServiceInstanceLogs operation to query deployment, upgrade, and application logs for a service instance
description_zh: 调用ListServiceInstanceLogs查询服务实例的部署，升级和应用等日志
kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier list-service-instance-logs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-id si-70a3b15bb626435b0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceInstanceLogs

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that specifies the next page of results to return. Set this parameter to the NextToken value from a previous response to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The source of the logs. Valid values:

application: Logs from the application.

computeNest: Logs from Compute Nest.

ros: Logs from Resource Orchestration Service (ROS)
parameters.help_zh:
日志来源。可选值：

application：应用自身的日志。

computeNest：计算巢打印的日志。

ros：来自资源编排的日志
parameters.name: log_source

parameters.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service Logstore
parameters.name: logstore

fields.help_en:
The name of the filter condition.

Valid values:

StartTime

EndTime

ApplicationGroupName

ResourceName

EventName
fields.help_zh:
过滤值名称。

可选值：
StartTime
EndTime
ApplicationGroupName
ResouceName
EventName
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The values for the filter condition. You can specify up to 10 values
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

Ascending: Ascending order.

Descending (default): Descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值范围：

Ascending：升序
Descending（默认值）：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的行数。每页最大100行，默认为20行

NextToken.description_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. If this parameter is empty, all results have been returned

ServiceInstancesLogs.description_en: The logs of the service instance

items.description_en: The details of a log entry

CompliancePackType.description_en: The threat type from the compliance package. This parameter is returned only when Source is set to compliancePack. For example, VpcDataRisk indicates a data security check within a VPC
CompliancePackType.description_zh: 合规包风险类型，当source为compliancePack时出现。如VPC内数据安全检查，VpcDataRisk

ComplianceRuleName.description_en: The name of the threat rule from the compliance package. This parameter is returned only when Source is set to compliancePack. For example, vpc-ecs-move-out-vpc indicates that an ECS instance was moved out of a VPC
ComplianceRuleName.description_zh: 合规包具体风险规则名，当source为compliancePack时出现。如ECS实例迁移出vpc-ecs-move-out-vpc

Content.description_en: The content of the log entry

LogType.description_en:
The log type. Valid values:

serviceInstance: Logs at the service instance level.

resource: Logs at the ROS resource level
LogType.description_zh:
日志类型。可能的值：

serviceInstance：服务实例层级产生的日志。

resource：ROS资源层级产生的日志

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the associated resource

Source.description_en:
The source of the log. Valid values:

ros: Logs from ROS.

computeNest: Logs from Compute Nest.

application: Logs from the application in the instance.

compliancePack: Logs from the compliance package of the instance.

actionTrail: Logs from ActionTrail
Source.description_zh:
服务实例日志的来源。可能的值：

ros：来源于资源编排ROS的日志。

computeNest：来源于计算巢的日志。
application: 来源于实例内应用日志
compliancePack: 来源于实例合规检测包的日志
actionTrail: 来源于操作审计

Status.description_en:
The status of the event that the log records. Valid values:

Creating: The instance is being created.

Created: The instance is created.

Deploying: The instance is being deployed.

Deployed: The instance is deployed.

DeployedFailed: The instance failed to be deployed.

Expired: The instance has expired.

ExtendSuccess: The instance is successfully renewed.

Upgrading: The instance is being upgraded.

UpgradeSuccess: The instance is successfully upgraded
Status.description_zh:
日志状态。可能的值：

Creating：创建中。

Created：已创建。

Deploying：部署中。

Deployed：已部署。

DeployedFailed：部署失败。

Expired：已过期。

ExtendSuccess：续费成功。

Upgrading：升级中。

UpgradeSuccess：升级成功

Timestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the log entry
Timestamp.description_zh: 服务实例日志的时间戳
